name: Check Transaction: Duplicate trade_no in Same Table (D-43)
description: CAP-06 LookupOrder / D-43: Verify behavior when multiple records in deposit_records share the same trade_no

queries.name: matching_deposit_records
queries.sql: SELECT id, no, trade_no, amount, status FROM deposit_records WHERE trade_no = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id ASC
